about.title: About
about.what: {site} plays PS1 games in your browser. Nothing to install: open the page, add a game, use the keyboard or a controller.
about.rule1: Only games that may legally be shared are hosted here: homebrew, freeware and demos with explicit permission. No commercial games and no BIOS files, ever.
about.rule2: Games you add yourself stay in your browser. They are never uploaded and we never see their names.
about.rule3: You can optionally add a BIOS file you own. It is stored in your browser like a game and never leaves it.
about.rule4: This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony. "PS1" is used only to describe compatibility.
about.licence1: This website is free software under the GNU GPL-3.0.
about.licence2: Emulation by EmulatorJS (GPL-3.0) running the libretro pcsx_rearmed core (GPL-2.0).
about.licence3: Fonts: Archivo Narrow, Inter and Chakra Petch under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

home.title: Library
home.empty: No games yet. Add a disc image below.

drop.title: Add your own game
drop.hint: Drop .chd, .pbp, .iso, .img, .bin + .cue, .m3u, .zip or .7z. We recommend .chd — it is the smallest.
drop.privacy: Nothing is uploaded. Files stay in this browser.

errors.missing-cue: A .bin needs its .cue sheet. Select both files together: {details}
errors.missing-bin: The .cue sheet refers to files that were not selected: {details}
errors.missing-m3u-disc: The .m3u playlist refers to discs that were not selected: {details}
errors.mixed: These files do not belong to one game: {details}. Add one game at a time.
errors.quota: This browser is out of storage space, so the game could not be saved. You can still play it right now.
errors.unavailable: Storage is unavailable in this browser (private mode?). Games cannot be kept between visits.

warnings.largeFile: This is a large image. The emulator keeps the whole file in memory, so low-memory devices may struggle. Converting to .chd makes it much smaller.
